solves.reasoning: (A) 'Depression is terrible' → terrible이 원문. (B) 'appears similar across sufferers' → similar이 원문. (C) 'a final third remain completely unaffected' → unaffected가 원문. → ②(A)terrible-(B)similar-(C)unaffected.

(A) 'It is a tragedy on an individual and a societal level' → tragedy가 원문. (B) 'a melting pot of diverse causes' → diverse가 원문. (C) 'diagnostic criteria for major depressive disorder' → diagnostic이 원문. → ①(A)tragedy-(B)diverse-(C)diagnostic.

(A) 'we struggle to grasp it' → grasp가 원문. (B) 'a melting pot of diverse causes and mechanisms' → mechanisms이 원문. (C) '227 possible symptom combinations that meet the diagnostic criteria...there is no one presentation' → presentation이 원문. → ③(A)grasp-(B)mechanisms-(C)presentation.
③decline: 'Antidepressants lead to decline in roughly a third of patients' → 원문은 improvement. decline(악화)은 반대. ①societal, ②treatment, ④unaffected는 적절.

①uniform: 'a uniform collection of symptoms that appears similar' → 원문은 symptoms이 similar하게 나타남을 설명하므로 uniform은 맥락 과잉/중복 부적절. 본문 핵심은 diverse causes인데 uniform 사용은 반대 뉘앙스. ②trauma, ③disorder, ④unaffected는 적절.
④financial: '227 possible symptom combinations that meet the financial criteria' → 원문은 diagnostic criteria. financial(재정적)은 맥락 부적합. ①grasp, ②collection, ③stem은 적절.
'we struggle to ____ it' — 의사 포함 모두가 우울증을 이해하기 어려워함. grasp(②=파악하다)가 원문. treat(치료), spread(퍼뜨리다), prevent(예방)는 맥락 부적합.
'one person's depressive episode seems to clearly ____ from recent life events' → 원문 'stem from' (비롯되다). stem(④)이 적합. recover(회복), differ(다르다), emerge(나타나다)는 맥락 부적합.
'227 possible symptom combinations that meet the ____ criteria for major depressive disorder' → 원문 diagnostic criteria(진단 기준). diagnostic(①). statistical(통계), ethical(윤리), financial(재정)은 부적합.
sufferers = 고통받는 사람들. patients(③=환자)가 동의어. researchers(연구자), specialists(전문가), physicians(의사)는 치료하는 측.
diverse = 다양한. varied(④=다양한)가 동의어. uniform(균일), limited(제한된), predictable(예측가능)은 반대 또는 다른 의미.
lifetime = 일생. lifespan(②=수명, 일생)이 동의어. childhood(아동기), generation(세대), routine(일상)은 다른 의미.
similar = 유사한. 반의어는 distinct(①=뚜렷이 다른). comparable(비교가능), equivalent(동등한), parallel(병행)은 유사어.
historic = 역사적인, 오래된. 반의어는 recent(④=최근의). ancient(고대), traditional(전통), memorable(기억할만한)은 다른 의미.
(A) 'episode seems to clearly stem from recent life events' → stem from = 비롯되다(동사). (B) 'cut the thick stem of the rose bush' → stem = 줄기(명사). → (A)비롯되다 (B)줄기 = ②.
영영풀이에서 '진단 기준을 충족하는 증상 조합' 등의 맥락으로 보아 disorder(③=장애)가 해당. symptom(증상), trauma(외상), therapy(치료)는 다른 의미.
명사 level을 수식하는 형용사 필요. society(명사) → societal(형용사). 'a tragedy on an individual and a societal level'.
문장 전체를 수식하는 부사 필요. understand(동사) → understandably(부사). 'Perhaps understandably, there is no one treatment'.

'depression is not one disease; it is a collection of symptoms...despite resulting from ____' → 'a melting pot of diverse causes and mechanisms'(③)이 원문. a single well-known cause(①), identical genetic factors(②), one specific traumatic event(④)는 다양성을 부정.

'Antidepressants lead to improvement in roughly a third of patients, offer some kind of improvement in another third, while ____' → 'a final third remain completely unaffected'(④)가 원문. all patients show full recovery(①), most experience severe side effects(②), works perfectly for everyone(③)는 틀림.
